# Third-party VFX

Textures under `public/assets/vfx/thirdparty/` are free for commercial use. Sheets were downscaled to 2048 px or smaller and saved as WebP. Grayscale or black-background sprites were converted to white-with-alpha so they can be tinted in the raid.

## Unity Labs Paris flipbooks — CC0

Houdini-rendered flipbooks (explosion, fireball, flame, wispy smoke, cloud, disc smoke, candle smoke).

Source: https://unity.com/blog/engine-platform/free-vfx-image-sequences-flipbooks (Thomas Iché, Unity Technologies, 2016).

License: CC0. The blog states these sequences are released under CC0 for use in projects. This is not Unity Asset Store content.

Used for the mage fire blast, warrior slam dust, boss impact bursts, burning cars, and smoke columns.

## Kenney Particle Pack — CC0

Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/particle-pack

License: CC0 1.0. https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

Used for slashes, sparks, and the thin flare core. Tinted to class colors in the raid.

## glow circle — CC0

"glow circle" by oglsdl (OpenGameArt.org), CC0.

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/glow-circle

Used for the heal halo and the shockwave ring.

## Lightning animation — CC0

"Lightning animation" by Calinou (OpenGameArt.org), CC0.

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/lightning-animation

Black background converted to alpha and drawn additively. Tinted to the mage lightning color.

## Lots of game effects — CC0

"Lots of game effects" by Soluna Software (OpenGameArt.org), CC0.

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/lots-of-game-effects

Directional fire sprite kept for flame accents.

## Colored summoning circles — CC-BY 3.0

"Colored summoning circles" by johndh (OpenGameArt.org), CC-BY 3.0.

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/colored-summoning-circles

Used as the small rune under the mage fire blast.
